title: ペア行動禁止違反の成立通知 R2

emissionContract.source: In scene, core is a soft section of the original slash, offset 0.85 design units toward the brass. The emitting section has a broad center, rounded ends tied to the currently grown segment, and a non-emitting vermilion margin on the far side. radiance rises into the original contact, peaks at 245 ms, then relaxes toward a held level without a second onset. Direct emission is weighted by core and post; the underlying vermilion is passive color.
emissionContract.receiver: The two existing band faces are the only receivers. coupling uses distance to the very same finite emitting axis, not distance to an infinite stop line. It falls to zero at 14 design units from the axis. The brass-weighted return uses the source drive and slash availability, then band coverage and availability. This spends the light across the width of each near end and a readable length behind it, rather than depending on a one-pixel glint. The remote brass and its passive edge shading remain as references; the gap is not a receiver.
emissionContract.observation: This is display-coordinate emission and reception on an abstract sign. No world light, body illumination, heat or impact is modeled. No separate observer bloom or flare: here the falloff outside the source is intentionally readable on material only. Pixel coverage is scale-aware; passive color, emission and reception are composed in linear light, then fs applies one sRGB encode with alpha 1. Use an opaque non-sRGB unorm attachment without host blending. No global gain or background change.

validation.sourceGate: The confirmed self-at [0,14] fixture, 48-byte uniform contract, vertex/fragment stages, one three-vertex draw, owner-only idle, and 940 ms lifetime are runtime contract requirements; they are not observed-playback evidence.
validation.emissionContractClarification: Original prose says zero by 14 design units; actual shader smoothstep(1,13,fromCore) reaches zero at 13. Original shader bytes retained.
